audit_status.source_base: Greek 3 John text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Complete one-chapter draft reviewed for Gaius, truth-walking, hospitality, Diotrephes domination, Demetrius witness.

verses.restored: The elder to beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.

familiar.text: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

verses.restored: Beloved, concerning all things I pray that you prosper and be healthy, just as your soul/life prospers.

familiar.text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

verses.restored: For I rejoiced greatly when siblings came and testified to your truth, just as you walk in truth.

familiar.text: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

verses.restored: I have no greater joy than these things: that I hear my children walking in truth.

familiar.text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

verses.restored: Beloved, you do trustworthily whatever you work for the siblings, and this for strangers,

familiar.text: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

verses.restored: who testified to your love before the assembly. You will do beautifully/well sending them forward in a manner worthy of the Divine.

familiar.text: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

verses.restored: For on behalf of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the nations.

familiar.text: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

verses.restored: Therefore we ought to receive such ones, so that we may become coworkers with the truth.

familiar.text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

verses.restored: I wrote something to the assembly, but Diotrephes, the one loving to be first among them, does not receive us.

familiar.text: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

verses.restored: Because of this, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works that he does, talking nonsense against us with harmful words; and not content with these, he neither receives the siblings himself, and those wanting to he hinders and casts out of the assembly.

familiar.text: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

verses.restored: Beloved, do not imitate the harmful but the good. The one doing good is from the Divine; the one doing harm has not seen the Divine.

familiar.text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

verses.restored: Demetrius has been testified to by all and by the truth itself; and we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

familiar.text: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

verses.restored: I had many things to write to you, but I do not wish to write to you through ink and reed.

familiar.text: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

verses.restored: But I hope to see you immediately, and we will speak mouth to mouth. Peace to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

familiar.text: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

translation_notes: Diotrephes is an anti-domination example: loving to be first, refusing accountability, blocking hospitality, and casting people out.
Hospitality is active partnership with truth.
Gaius' health/soul blessing should not be turned into prosperity formula.
